messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acmeai.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmeai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC capacity & success criteria follow-up - Acme AI

Hi Samir / Lena -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before we draft the SOW:

1) Success criteria (what Acme will use to evaluate the POC)
   - API latency: 95th percentile <= 250ms for production prompt set (50-75 tokens)
   - Accuracy: automated eval pass rate >= 92% on the benchmark prompt set we ran today
   - Cost target: token cost <= $0.0025 per request (target visible in Redwood Console)
   - Reliability: no more than 1 minute of total downtime per day for the POC window

2) Evaluation plan / timelines
   - POC length: 4 weeks (start target: Aug 2, 2026)
   - Week 0: infra provisioning + smoke tests
   - Weeks 1-3: run eval traffic, run regen tests, surface regressions
   - Week 4: final report + go/no-go decision

3) Capacity ask (what we discussed)
   - Baseline reserved capacity: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved)
   - Autoscaling headroom: scale up to 16 GPUs for bursts (policy: scale based on 95th pct token throughput)
   - Expected concurrency: 20 concurrent sessions, peak QPS ~100 (you confirmed this on the call)
   - KV cache: enabled for prefix reuse across requests (saves latency/cost)

4) Ownership / next steps
   - Samir: confirm final success criteria + provide expected_traffic.xlsx with traffic patterns (attachments)
   - Marissa: draft SOW + send for signatures (POC_SOW_v1.pdf attached as draft)
   - Vivek / Priyom (SEs): confirm recommended instance types, autoscale policies, and baseline cost estimate

If that matches your notes, reply with any edits and we’ll schedule a technical sync between Vivek and your infra lead next week.

Thanks -
Marissa

Thanks Marissa - this is great and aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications and requests:

- Success criteria: Confirmed. We'll share a small holdout set for the final accuracy check in week 4.
- Traffic: peak QPS ~100, sustained QPS during business hours ~40, concurrency target 20. I've attached the expected_traffic.xlsx with hourly patterns.
- Capacity: based on our internal benchmarks, we think baseline 8 A100-equivalent GPUs is fine, but we want autoscale to 16 for heavy bursts (e.g., product demo days).
- Cold-start tolerance: we can tolerate up to 300ms cold-start for new containers, but KV caching should keep most requests warm.

Action items:
- I'll introduce our infra lead (Lena) on a separate thread to coordinate firewall/VPC peering and certs.
- Please have Vivek propose a configuration and cost estimate so we can sign the SOW.

Looking forward.

Samir

Subject: Internal: POC config ask - Acme AI (see external thread)

Vivek / Priyom -

Looping you in to confirm we can propose the following for the SOW (Samir already agreed in principle):

Proposed configuration (to translate into SOW language and an estimated monthly cost for the 4-week POC):
- Baseline: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved for POC)
- Autoscale: up to 16 GPUs for bursts, policy: scale when 95th pct token throughput > 70% sustained for 2 minutes
- Instance types: 4x A100-80GB or 8x A100-40GB (provide both cost options)
- Networking: VPC peering + static IP for callbacks; Samir to share firewall rules via Lena
- Monitoring: enable per-token latency/trace, per-route cost breakdown, and daily health check report
- Fallbacks: configure model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model if latency SLOs are breached

Questions for the SOW/estimate:
1) Cost delta for reserved 8 -> 16 scaling for 1-2 hour bursts per day (e.g., demo days) - provide sample cost for 2 hr/day of bursting for a 4-week window
2) Validation runbook - steps to validate performance and failover (I can draft, but need SE input)
3) Any infra pre-reqs Lena will need for peering/certs (we should include checklist in the SOW)

Can you take a first pass on the proposal and numbers by Monday EOD so I can attach to the SOW? I'll handle sign-offs and the DocuSign flow.

Thanks -
Marissa

Subject: Re: POC capacity & success criteria follow-up - Acme AI

Thanks Marissa - I'll take this on. Quick notes from a capacity/ops perspective:

- Recommended baseline: 8 x A100-80GB for lowest latency on the 75-token median prompts; if Acme prefers cost savings, we can propose 8 x A100-40GB + aggressive KV caching (results in ~10-12% higher latency) - I'll include both options in the estimate.
- Autoscaling plan: we'll use a target-based policy (95th pct token throughput) and pre-warm by 1 GPU when predicted ramp > 2x sustained for 3 minutes to prevent cold-start spikes.
- Burst pricing example: 2 hours/day at +8 GPUs over baseline for 4 weeks = estimated incremental cloud cost $3,200-$4,100 (depends on instance choice). I'll produce an exact cost table in the estimate.
- Runbook: will draft smoke tests, perf-validation steps (latency/accuracy checks), and rollback steps if model regressions occur.

I'll have a first draft of the config + cost estimate and runbook by Monday EOD (July 15). Planning a technical sync with Samir & Lena on Tues to confirm peering/certs.

Vivek
